In page-305.md, lines 17-19 are a markdown table with only the constant-entry row. Line 20 is blank, which ends the table, and line 21 holds 'screen-description-entry 13.17, Screen description entry' as a loose paragraph with no cell separators. Both sources are quoted accurately. The wording is intact, so the meaning a person reads does not change. The structure is genuinely wrong, though: anything that parses the table finds one meta-language term where the standard defines two. This is a real structural defect, not a normative one.
